rca_of_issue: Red screen RCA: MessaScreen had an early return `if (loading || !fixedParts) return <ActivityIndicator/>;` at line 59, then TWO additional useState hooks declared further down (originally lines 194-195). On first render (loading=true) only the top hooks were executed; once the effect finished loading, render re-executed and the lower useState hooks were now also reached, so React saw additional hook calls and threw 'Rendered more hooks than during the previous render.' Fix: moved `useState("A")` for congedoId and benedizioneId above the early return so hook order is stable across renders.
